messages.content: I have an outdoor summer rooftop wedding coming up next Saturday. Dress code is Smart Casual / Cocktail. What should I wear?

For a summer rooftop wedding with a smart casual / cocktail dress code, the key is balancing elegance with warm-weather breathability:

1. **Men / Masculine Styling:**
   • **Top & Outerwear:** A breathable deconstructed linen-blend or tropical wool blazer in soft sage, light navy, or sand. Pair with a crisp white or light blue open-collar cotton-linen dress shirt (skip the tie for a relaxed rooftop vibe).
   • **Bottoms:** Tailored cream or taupe pleated trousers.
   • **Footwear:** Dark brown suede penny loafers or leather double monk straps with invisible no-show socks.
   • **Finishing Touches:** A linen pocket square and classic dark tortoiseshell sunglasses for daytime sun.

2. **Women / Feminine Styling:**
   • **The Look:** A breezy floral silk or chiffon midi dress with an asymmetrical hemline or halter neckline, or a sleek pastel linen-blend tailored jumpsuit.
   • **Footwear:** Block-heel strappy sandals (essential for rooftop wooden decking where stilettos can catch).
   • **Accessories:** A compact woven raffia or metallic clutch, delicate gold drop earrings, and cat-eye sunglasses.

💡 *Pro-Stylist Tip:* Rooftops can get breezy after sunset. Bring along a lightweight cashmere wrap or unstructured blazer that coordinates with your palette!
Can I wear black leather Chelsea boots with navy blue chinos, or does that clash?

Yes, absolutely! The old-school rule that 'black and navy never mix' is thoroughly outdated in modern menswear and tailoring. In fact, navy and black create a very sophisticated, European-inspired high-contrast look when styled intentionally.

Here is how to make it look cohesive:
1. **The Bridge Piece:** Wear a black leather belt with brushed silver or gunmetal hardware to echo the black boots.
2. **Upper Layer:** Pair with a charcoal, grey melange, or off-white knit sweater or an ivory Oxford shirt. If you wear an outer jacket, a black overcoat or dark grey bomber ties the boots and chinos together seamlessly.
3. **Trouser Fit:** Ensure your navy chinos have a clean, slight taper and a neat single cuff or no-break hem that sits cleanly on top of the Chelsea boot shaft without bunching up.

This look is sleek, urban, and perfect for smart-casual office settings or evening drinks!
I'm going to a job interview at a high-growth tech startup. What is the best business casual outfit that looks polished without looking too stiff?

At a modern tech startup, wearing a traditional corporate suit can make you seem culturally out of touch, while showing up in a graphic tee and sneakers looks under-prepared. The sweet spot is **'Elevated Contemporary Business Casual'**:

• **Upper Body:** A fine-gauge merino wool knit polo or a crisp light blue button-down shirt worn beneath an unstructured navy or charcoal blazer. Soft shoulders give an approachable yet professional aura.
• **Trousers:** Clean-front slim or straight-leg chinos in olive, khaki, or dark slate grey. Avoid denim with visible distress or fading; dark raw denim is acceptable only if tailored.
• **Footwear:** Clean, minimalist leather dress shoes (Derbies or loafers) or pristine, unbranded luxury low-top white leather sneakers.
• **Accessories:** A minimalist leather watch and a structured leather laptop bag or portfolio.

This ensemble signals that you take the opportunity seriously while fitting effortlessly into a collaborative, modern workplace.
